$comment: Dependency license policy (CLAUDE.md rule 8). scripts/check-licenses.js reads package-lock.json and fails on anything not allowed here. Every exception needs a reason and a review date.

ffmpeg-static.reason: Optional dependency bundling a GPL ffmpeg build. Used only for local installs; the Docker image installs with --ignore-scripts and uses the distro ffmpeg via FFMPEG_PATH. Never redistributed.

@img/sharp-libvips-*.reason: Prebuilt libvips dynamically loaded by sharp; LGPL obligations are met by not modifying it. Attribution kept via node_modules.

@img/sharp-wasm32.reason: sharp WebAssembly fallback; same terms as libvips above.

@img/sharp-win32-*.reason: sharp Windows prebuilds (not installed on Linux); same terms as libvips above.

parse-cache-control.reason: Transitive dependency of ffmpeg-static; LICENSE file is the BSD 3-clause text (checked 2026-11-13).
